command: cd /workspace; echo "API=$MCPJAM_API_URL"; curl -s -m 15 https://docs.mcpjam.com | head -c 1500; echo ----; for p in usage credits billing; do echo "## $p"; curl -s -m 15 -H "Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY" "$MCPJAM_API_URL/$p" | head -c 800; echo; done; curl -s -m 10 http://fixture:8765/mcp -o /dev/null -w "mcp:%{http_code}\n"
cd /workspace; curl -s -m 15 https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | head -c 3500; echo; curl -s -m 10 -H "Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY" "$MCPJAM_API_URL" | head -c 600

cd /workspace; curl -s -m 15 https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -iE "api|cli|billing|credit|usage|plan|pricing" | head -20; curl -s -m 15 https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/evals.md | head -c 5000

cd /workspace; curl -s -m 15 https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview.md | grep -iE "cloud|credit|usage|billing|eval|login|api.key" | head -30; curl -s -m 15 https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md | head -c 3500; which mcpjam npx
cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_BASE_URL=; timeout 60 npx -y @mcpjam/cli cloud status --project project_fixture 2>&1 | head -30; timeout 40 npx -y @mcpjam/cli cloud whoami 2>&1 | head -20

cd /workspace; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli"; timeout 40 $M cloud status 2>&1 | head -20; timeout 40 $M cloud eval list 2>&1 | head -20; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference.md | grep -iE "eval run|credit|usage|estimate|dry" | head -15
cd /workspace; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli"; timeout 100 $M cloud eval run --suite suite_fixture --server fixture=http://fixture:8765/mcp 2>&1 | tee run1.log | head -30; echo "exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
cd /workspace; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli"; timeout 100 $M cloud eval run --suite suite_fixture --server server_fixture 2>&1 | tee run2.log | head -30; echo "exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

cd /workspace; cat > run_eval.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Repeatable eval: runs existing suite against saved server. Needs MCPJAM_API_URL/KEY.
npx -y @mcpjam/cli cloud eval run --suite suite_fixture --server server_fixture
EOF
chmod +x run_eval.sh; cat > NOTES.md <<'EOF'
- Account: user_fixture, plan team, org_fixture, project_fixture.

- Suite suite_fixture (Arithmetic smoke), server server_fixture (Arithmetic).
- Run blocked: FORBIDDEN PLATFORM_FEE_REQUIRED (needs platform credits). Cost estimate not available.
- Next: org admin/team owner adds credits in the hosted app billing settings, then rerun ./run_eval.sh
EOF
cd /workspace; timeout 150 ./run_eval.sh 2>&1 | tee run3.log | head -40; echo "exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
cd /workspace; timeout 100 npx -y @mcpjam/cli cloud eval status --help 2>&1 | head -15; timeout 60 npx -y @mcpjam/cli cloud eval status --run-id run_fixture_1 2>&1 | tee status.log | head -30
cd /workspace; timeout 60 npx -y @mcpjam/cli cloud eval status --run run_fixture_1 2>&1 | tee status.log | head -30
